data.name: Sudershan
data.gender_notes: Sudershan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: He who has auspicious or good deeds. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sudh' which means pure and 'Rasana' which means having good or auspicious deeds. The name Sudershan carries the meaning “Good or Auspicious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sudershan usually hope their child will grow to embody good or auspicious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who want to lead a virtuous life and have good deeds.
data.etymology: Sudershan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good or Auspicious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudershan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sudershan holds immense significance in Hindu culture, especially in the context of Lord Sudershan known as theGod of Consciousness or Pure Consciousness. This deity is depicted with a single largest eye representing the collective consciousness of the universe. Worshiping Lord Sudershan is believed to help in the attainment of inner peace, wisdom, and pure consciousness. The name is also chanted during auspicious occasions or for the wellbeing of ancestors.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Sudershan lies in its connection to the quest for inner purity and wisdom. In Hindu philosophy, it is believed that by calling upon Lord Sudershan, one can develop the qualities of a pure and enlightened conscience. The name is a reminder to strive for good deeds and pure thoughts, leading towards spiritual growth. As Mahatma Gandhi once said, "The only devotion which I have is to the purification of my thoughts." Adopting this devotion to inner purity strengthens one's connection with the divine and is a path towards self-realization and personal transformation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sudershan symbolizes the pure and unchanging consciousness within us. The name is derived from the Sanskrit words "Sudha" meaning pure and "Dharshan" meaning sight or vision. It represents the inner radiance of self-realization and divine awareness.
